changes.source: Place an Exploration Flag at the enemy base; assign 1 explorer. Flags request units autonomously. An explorer reveals current activity through fog of war; it may stop to eat.

changes.source: Paint a guard zone in the marked area and let 2 warriors reach it. Open Flags, choose Guard and paint at least 4 tiles inside the area. Guard zones attract idle warriors. Forbidden zones block travel; clearing zones request resource removal.
